g.text: Sec 4.5.1 · periodic n_eff modulation → many small reflections → stop band at λB

g.text: Takeaway: distributed reflections add in phase only near λB ≈ 1529 nm (R ≈ 0.98, T ≈ 0.02, ~11 nm wide); CMT ≈ TMM to 0.3% — TMM alone does arbitrary profiles.
